host_guard.block_rule: Record raw whole-host, runner, B/C process, load and CPU pressure counters. PostgreSQL is an owned measured service in another process, so do not label host-minus-B/C CPU as unrelated automatically.
host_guard.interference_rule: During collection only, an operator must immediately flag observed unrelated build, test or compute work. The runner fsyncs time/process/reason/load/pressure to the journal and invalidates the entire attempt before numeric analysis. No block is filtered and no retry is allowed.
host_guard.unavailable_counters: Fail closed before or during capture.

materiality_reasons.unrelated-build: An unrelated build competes for host CPU, memory bandwidth or storage during the measured workflow.
materiality_reasons.unrelated-test: An unrelated test suite competes for host CPU, memory bandwidth or storage during the measured workflow.
materiality_reasons.unrelated-compute: An unrelated compute task materially competes with the measured workflow.

conditions.network: IPv4 loopback, two warm HTTP/1.1 inference hops, no inference TLS
conditions.reference: Historical native strict gateway plus independently authored encrypted submission/journal/atomic-ready barrier
conditions.candidate: Production negotiated OpenAI Chat-to-Anthropic translated continuation
conditions.resources: Client, provider, gateway or relay, oracle and instrumentation in arm process; PostgreSQL process excluded
